evidence:
Walked instruction.md and hireops_rules.md line by line against solution/app. Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation:
- Staff views Board/Conversations/Activity, candidate 'My applications' view: app.js:122-126 buildViews; sign-in/out app.js:236-247; login form index.html:18-27.
- Roles and 401/403/404: index.js:73-81 auth(), threadAccess 114-120, application() 121-131 (candidate 404), mayMove 326-333, staffOnly 378-385.
- Open job (recruiter, HM from HM accounts, places 1-50): index.js:202-214; form board.js:61-81. Add candidate to bottom of Applied, email validity, case-insensitive per-job duplicate, candidate-account linking: index.js:216-233; error shown at email field with typed text kept board.js:47-60. Generated ids index.js:60.
- Six stages, one-step moves, reject from any non-Hired stage with non-blank reason, rejected_from remembered, reopen only to that stage with reason cleared: index.js:238-265, 311-314. Ordinary controls (Move-to select, Move, Up/Down) plus optional drag: board.js:208-244, 300-319.
- Shared manual order surviving reload/restart (positions in SQLite): index.js:199-200, 296-318; reorder via before_id board.js:233-241.
- Interview places enforced, reorder inside always allowed, freed place usable: index.js:290-295 (entering excludes cards already in Interview).
- HM limits (own job, Interview/Offer/Hired, reject from Interview/Offer, reopen those): index.js:257-264; client targets board.js:144-162.
- Version conflict 409 naming who (last activity detail carries actor name): index.js:241-245; optimistic move, put back, reason, focus to card: board.js:181-205, fail 166-171.
- Bulk all-or-nothing, board order, places counted for set: index.js:274-321 (single immediate transaction), 339-344; bulk bar board.js:277-290.
- Undo own latest move/bulk, restore stage/place/reason, refused if any card changed (version) or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by later move; notes do not bump version: index.js:165-168, 348-373; button board.js:291-299, 367-368.
- Card detail with internal notes; recruiter any, HM own jobs, observer reads; per-person per-browser note draft: index.js:386-398; board.js:85-141 (keep key includes user id app.js:74-78).
- Activity: every open/add/move/reject(with reason)/reopen/reorder/undo logged as readable line, never edited, refused actions roll back with transaction: index.js:195-198, 211, 230, 266-271, 315-316, 366; Activity view newest-first with All jobs / one job filter: app.js:80-120, index.js:189.
- Live updates without reload preserving typing/focus/open card/conversation/scroll: SSE index.js:45-54, 102-107; app.js:165-199; keyed in-place patching board.js:321-341, threads.js:36-65.
- Conversations: participation rules index.js:114-131; plain-text non-blank with line breaks (pre-wrap styles.css:105); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused after send, failed send keeps text with error: threads.js:183-201. Latest 30, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count, scroll anchor kept: index.js:401-417, threads.js:76-90, 160-175. Unread per person, own never unread, sending marks read, per-conversation and total badges: index.js:132-139, 159, 424-426; threads.js:221, app.js:150-156. New-message pill when scrolled up, not marked read: threads.js:145-159, 176-181. Seen receipt with observer excluded: index.js:143-155, threads.js:76-83.
- Drafts per person+conversation+browser, survive switch/reload/session end, other users see none: threads.js:112,124,182; app.js:69, 222-230.
- Candidate read model (title, team, candidate wording; no notes/reason/rejected_from/position/others/activity), no auto-open conversation: index.js:171-176; threads.js:7.
- Runtime: node /app/server.js, PORT, /api/health answered before DB (bootstrap.js:56-62), DB_PATH default /app/app.db (db.js:8), seed copied beside module and loaded once (db.js:9, 60-61), files resolved from __dirname; seed copy identical to /assets/seed_data.json.
Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index artifacts and all 12 listed solution source hashes re-verified to match the frozen task bytes; qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json records 25 scripted golden groups all passed=true with page_errors [] (covers transitions, places, stale 409 naming mover, roles, undo/bulk, notes, live board arrival_ms 804, 30-message paging, unread/seen, drafts, session loss, observer, restart). That is scripted golden evidence only, not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score.
Counterexample attempts: (1) broken app that could pass - not applicable to this row's direction; looked for a brief capability the golden lacks (Activity single-job filter, rejection reason in log line, email field error, HM notes, total unread, candidate no-auto-open, health before DB) and found each implemented. (2) Conforming alternative - golden choices (SSE vs polling, select+button controls, localStorage drafts) are not required by the brief, so they do not narrow conformity for this row.
Minor observations (not coverage gaps): Activity view pages 50 at a time with 'Show more' (app.js:81,118) - all entries reachable; failed-send message shows the server error text and prefixes 'Not sent.' only for network failure (threads.js:194), draft kept either way; SSE reconnect on 401 does not itself trigger the sign-in prompt, but the brief allows 'at the latest on the next action that needs the server' (api() app.js:69). Measured runtime for all-criteria judging is outside this row.
run_verdict: CONFIRMED (scripted golden observations, workspace.json: 25/25 groups passed=true, page_errors []; hashes match frozen solution)
